source.description: Deterministic macOS say speech prompts for smoke/latency regression testing. These files are synthetic and must not be used as human accuracy evidence.
source.generation_policy: Run say once per manifest item, then afconvert to mono 16 kHz PCM WAV. Keep the exact manifest text and generated audio hash in benchmark results.
